- **F1 (SCMU Crawler & KB)**:

  - `test_f1_04_characteristic_campus_imagery`: Verifies corpus covers core imagery (双塔, 南湖, 石榴籽, 军训, 教官).

### Tier 2: Boundary & Corner Cases (`TestTier2BoundaryAndCorner`, 40 tests)
- **F1 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f1_b01_malformed_json_handling`: Malformed JSON handling.
  - `test_f1_b02_date_format_conformity`: All dates conform to `YYYY-MM-DD`.
  - `test_f1_b03_no_empty_content`: No article has empty or whitespace-only content.
  - `test_f1_b04_url_scheme_and_domain`: All URLs strictly start with `http` and target `scuec.edu.cn`.
  - `test_f1_b05_content_minimum_length`: Total corpus length exceeds 250,000 characters.
- **F2 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f2_b01_query_cli_empty_string`: Empty query string handled cleanly without crash.
  - `test_f2_b02_query_cli_nonexistent_term`: Nonexistent keyword returns 0 results cleanly.
  - `test_f2_b03_query_cli_regex_special_chars`: Meta-characters `.*[]()|^$` handled safely.
  - `test_f2_b04_query_cli_strict_exit_code`: `--strict` returns exit code 1 when 0 results found.
  - `test_f2_b05_query_cli_invalid_limit`: Zero/negative limit handled safely.
- **F3 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f3_b01_score_bounds_in_report`: All 76 photo scores strictly bounded in [0.0, 100.0].
  - `test_f3_b02_highlight_clipping_threshold`: Photos with clipping ≥ 10% flagged with issues or Tier C.
  - `test_f3_b03_sharpness_extreme_rejection`: Blurry photos (< 10.0 sharpness) in Tier C.
  - `test_f3_b04_luminance_extremes`: Extreme luminance (< 40 or > 180) triggers issues.
  - `test_f3_b05_tier_assignment_monotonicity`: A+ scores strictly exceed C scores.
- **F4 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f4_b01_exact_76_photo_set`: Exact set match between USB files and report entries.
  - `test_f4_b02_blacklisted_photo_img3879`: `IMG_3879.JPG` has overexposure issue and Tier C.
  - `test_f4_b03_blacklisted_photo_img3878`: `IMG_3878.JPG` has clipping issue and Tier C.
  - `test_f4_b04_underexposed_photo_penalties`: `IMG_3841.JPG` / `IMG_3849.JPG` in Tier C.
  - `test_f4_b05_usb_images_loadable`: Sample photos across USB are loadable with non-zero dimensions.
- **F5 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f5_b01_forbidden_verb_zhudao`: "铸造中华民族共同体意识" triggers POL-001 BLOCKER.
  - `test_f5_b02_forbidden_supervisor`: "教育部直属的中南民族大学" triggers POL-005 BLOCKER.
  - `test_f5_b03_motto_typo`: "笃信好学，自然和谐" triggers SCMU-003 WARNING.
  - `test_f5_b04_museum_typo`: "民俗博物馆" triggers SCMU-005 WARNING.
  - `test_f5_b05_lake_geography_typo`: "东湖之滨的中南民族大学" triggers SCMU-006 WARNING.
- **F6 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f6_b01_empty_string_compliance`: Empty text returns 0 issues.
  - `test_f6_b02_unclosed_quote_suggestion`: Unclosed quote triggers FMT-002.
  - `test_f6_b03_h1_trailing_punctuation`: Title ending with exclamation triggers FMT-001.
  - `test_f6_b04_missing_colophon_detection`: Long draft missing colophon triggers STRUC-001.
  - `test_f6_b05_cli_nonexistent_file`: CLI on nonexistent file exits with code 2.
- **F7 Boundaries**:
  - `test_f7_b01_missing_photo_graceful_handling`: Missing photo returns empty string safely.
  - `test_f7_b02_extreme_scaling_aspect_ratio`: Scaling maintains aspect ratio.
  - `test_f7_b03_xiumi_html_size_bounds`: HTML package between 1MB and 10MB.
